item.title: Silent Clip Subtitle Check

turns.text: Can you subtitle this clip? If there's no speech in the audio, just tell me.

item.tests: Tests recognizing absent speech and reporting it instead of fabricating subtitles from visible mouth movements or a related source.

answer_sheet.Subtitle language: English if there is audible speech.
answer_sheet.What to do without speech: Just tell me there is no audible speech to subtitle; no edited video is needed.
answer_sheet.Missing transcript or replacement audio: I am not supplying either. Do not invent dialogue or add a voice.
answer_sheet.Response wording: Your call; a short explanation is fine.

must_haves: The response clearly states that the supplied clip has no audible speech to transcribe.
No dialogue is inferred from the woman's mouth movements or borrowed from another clip.
No subtitled video, fabricated transcript, or replacement voice is presented.
The response does not claim the silent file contains recognizable spoken words.

turns.text: Can you subtitle this clip? If there's no speech in the audio, just tell me.

dialog.agent:
Before I go on I need one thing:
· Which language?
dialog.user: English if there is audible speech.

turns.agent: I'll use the subtitles tool to detect speech and add English subtitles if any is audible. If there is no speech, I'll tell you and leave the clip unchanged.

fields.value: Check for audible speech; add English subtitles if speech is audible, otherwise tell the user there is no speech.
fields.quote: Can you subtitle this clip? If there's no speech in the audio, just tell me. English if there is audible speech.
English if there is audible speech.

goal.why: The user requests conditional subtitling of an existing supplied clip.

plan.say: I'll use the subtitles tool to detect speech and add English subtitles if any is audible. If there is no speech, I'll tell you and leave the clip unchanged.

params.extra: Language: English; whole clip; conditional output: create the subtitled clip only if audible speech is detected, otherwise report no audible speech and leave the original unchanged.
params.prompt_or_change: Detect audible speech; if present, add English subtitles while preserving the original video and audio; if absent, return a no-speech notice without adding subtitles.

steps.why: Speech detection during captioning determines whether subtitles are needed.
